chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
When Allah intends to humiliate a servant, He denies him knowledge.
ai.seo_question: What is the sign of divine humiliation for a servant according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this saying from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies the withholding of beneficial knowledge as a specific form of divine humiliation (arzala), reflecting the Shia concept that true knowledge is a light (nur) granted by God. This denial serves as a spiritual punishment, rendering the individual incapable of recognizing truth or fulfilling their religious duties, thereby confirming the hadith's theme of divine retribution through intellectual deprivation.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 288. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
When Allāh intends to humiliate a person He denies him knowledge.
